title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: How you gather the team
hook: When you talk to the team, where is the sun?
intro: Kids stand in a line facing you.
The sun is in their eyes and the field is behind you.
statement: Where kids stand changes how well they listen.
q1: Do you gather kids in a circle at your level —
q2: or line them up so everyone faces you?
q3: What are they looking at besides you?
t1: Every coach is different. But talks land better
t2: when kids can see you and nothing else.
cta: Coaches — how do you gather the team?
ctaLines: Circle. Line facing away from the sun. Take a knee.
ctaPrompt: Share your team talk habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
When you talk to the team, where is the sun?
Kids stand in a line facing you. The sun is in their eyes and the field is behind you.
Where kids stand changes how well they listen.
A circle or a line. Every team is different.
How do you gather the team? Share your habit in the comments.
